text:
Alice Chen: Heads-up - planning a quick frontend deploy for console v3.14 in ~20m. Need someone for smoke, and a CDN/cache invalidation check. I can kick off canary.
Jamal Ortiz: I can run smoke tests after canary is up. What time exactly?
Alice Chen: targeting 18:30 UTC (in ~20m). Canary for 5 minutes, then staggered rollout. Will post canary slot when ready.
Nina Patel: I can handle CDN invalidation. Which CDN and which path patterns do we need to purge?
Alice Chen: Fastly + browser caches. Assets path: /static/console/* and /assets/icons/*
Alice Chen: Use this purge command for Fastly (ops key with limited TTL):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.fastly.com/service/<SERVICE_ID>/purge" \
  -H "Fastly-Key: $FASTLY_KEY" \
  -d "surrogate_key=console-assets"
```
Mike O'Leary: For immediate browser cache busting we'll also bump asset manifest; already built into this release, so should be OK.
deploy-bot: Canary slot opened for console-v3.14 @ slot-canary-2 — health checks passing.
Jamal Ortiz: Canary is healthy at +2m, smoke checklist started: login flows, nav links, workspace list, editor load.
Jamal Ortiz: Quick note: editor load latency looks ~80ms higher in canary for small sample. digging.
Nina Patel: Purged Fastly surrogate_key=console-assets. Propagation looks good from two regions.
Alice Chen: Good call. Jamal, if editor latency regresses beyond 200ms over baseline, we rollback. Can you verify perf at +4m?
Jamal Ortiz: Will report at +5m.
SRE oncall: Watch traces for N+1 on query for /workspace/list. If you see spike, alert #eng-sre.
Mike O'Leary: Rollback plan: tag v3.13.9 is ready and Docker image is available. Steps:
1) revert route to canary slot (5m)
2) trigger deploy rollback script: `./deploy/rollback.sh console v3.13.9`
3) purge new assets if necessary
Nina Patel: Done with a second purge targeting `/assets/icons/*` explicitly.
Jamal Ortiz: Smoke at +5m: login ok, navigation ok, editor load back to baseline after cache warm-up. No rollback.
Alice Chen: Great. Proceeding to slow rollout to 50% over next 15m. I'll post once at 100%.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 50% initiated for console-v3.14.
Alice Chen: Thanks all — next check at +20m. Ping me if anything odd appears. :thumbsup:
